description: Tiling window manager for Windows - tiling only, no bar, no widgets. C# / .NET NativeAOT.
pre_uninstall: # ytiled and ykeys lock their own binaries, so scoop cannot remove or
# replace them while they run - and an update is an uninstall first.
Get-Process ytiled, ykeys -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
notes: Start it with:  ytile start        (brings up the bundled ykeys hotkey daemon too)
Run at login:   ytile autostart on
Config lives outside the scoop directory, so upgrades never touch it:
Elevated windows (Task Manager and other auto-elevating system tools) can only
be tiled by an elevated daemon. 'ytile start --elevated' works and prompts once
per session. 'ytile autostart on --elevated' will be REFUSED for a scoop install:
it registers a logon task at run level HIGHEST, which must point at a directory
only administrators can write, and scoop installs under your own profile. For
silent elevated autostart, install for all users instead:
